@world flat
@gamemode survival
@difficulty easy
@observe 30

/gamerule doDaylightCycle false

/weather clear

/forceload add -96 -112 96 112
wait 40
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player]
wait 5
report WALK walk-13 14 pairs
